text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming formidable rivals, it was 
Vivlos who conquered the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her defeat, Cheval Grand praised 
her and decided to travel to Dubai 
alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having become an "ultra-celebrity," Vivlos 
sets her sights on the dazzling celebrity 
land of Dubai alongside her beloved family 
and Trainer—this time for real.
